get_lvis_metadata: get LVIS instance metadata including thing classes from an LVIS API object
visualize_lvis_dataset: run the module to load LVIS annotations and visualize dataset samples with bounding boxes

refactor_lvis_loader: refactor the extended_lvis_load function to support additional annotation formats or metadata fields
